summary.text: Chris Henry, also known as Kit, a Pacific Green Party and Progressive Party community advocate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Oregon to Jeff Merkley.
He has worked as a union truck driver and aircraft mechanic and has run for statewide and county office several times, including for Oregon treasurer in 2016 and 2020.
Little other biographical detail is public.

paragraphs.text: Henry says in his Ballotpedia survey that he was the ninth of twelve children and that his grandfather, Kevin McCann, was President Eisenhower's speechwriter.

He graduated from the UAW Trade School in 1985, and his career experience includes work as a union truck driver, aircraft mechanic and community advocate. He has been affiliated with Honest Elections Oregon.
Henry ran for Oregon treasurer as a Pacific Green and Progressive candidate in 2016, and again in 2020, when he received 4.4% (99,870 votes) in the general election won by incumbent Tobias Read.
In 2024 he ran in the May 21 nonpartisan primary for Multnomah County Commission District 1 but did not advance; Meghan Moyer and Vadim Mozyrsky advanced to the general election.
He received 2.2% of the vote to Jeff Merkley's 58.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
